title: MIDIMonster value-less OSC mixer queries
problem: MIDIMonster cannot send the value-less OSC messages used to query current channel state from Behringer XAir and X32 mixers.
reproduce: Map an incoming OSC trigger to /ch/01/mix/fader and capture the outgoing mixer datagram.
acceptance: The query channel emits the OSC path with an empty type tag and no value bytes on every mapped event; ordinary float output remains unchanged.
repair: Add an explicit query channel format that keeps an internal trigger parameter while serializing a standards-compliant zero-argument OSC message.

verification.limitations: The test exercises the real MIDIMonster core and OSC backend over loopback. It does not verify a physical XAir or X32 mixer.
verification.ownerCheck: Run the candidate with an XAir/X32 destination, trigger the configured query, and confirm that the mixer returns the current fader value. Record mixer model, firmware and observed reply.
